body: Part of #2349 (read it for the safety requirements). Behind `experimental.richChatContent`. ## Build 1. **Normalize** an `image` chat block across drivers: Codex `imageGeneration` (+ `imageView` preview), ACP image blocks, Claude tool-result image blocks. Persist bytes to `/agent-logs/chat//media/.` and keep `{ mediaRef, mimeType, width?, height?, sourcePath? }` in the transcript. 2. **Inline rendering**: a lazy thumbnail (max ~240px, decoded off the main thread or via `createImageBitmap`), inside the tool row for tool-result images, and a click-to-open lightbox (zoom, copy, reveal in Finder/Explorer). Remote image URLs show a "Load image" chip and never fetch automatically. 3. **File chips**: detect paths in agent text and tool output (absolute or relative to the agent cwd, Windows paths, `:line[:col]` suffixes). Show a chip only if main confirms the file exists inside the allowlist. Popover preview: Monaco read-only for text (size cap), image viewer, `
title: [MEDIUM] Rich chat content: inline images from all harnesses and file chips with previews (experimental)
